📉 An Economist/YouGov poll out Tuesday had Trump's approval rating among Republicans at a second-term low of 79 percent — a decline of 12 points from shortly after he took office.
   In that time, the percentage of Republicans who "strongly approve" of Trump's performance has dropped more precipitously —by 20 points (from 68 to 48 percent). [...] Trump is barely above water among non-MAGA Republicans, who make up about 30 percent of the party. Only 51 percent approved of his performance, vs. 47 percent who disapproved.
